c1-wrong-title-real-id: resolvable ID attached to a different paper's title
c3-right-paper-false-claim: correct paper/title, claim contradicted by the paper
c5-web-only: web/book source only, no arXiv ID or DOI
c6-pmid-only: key paper cited by PMID only
c7-generic-citation-line: correct ID, terse citation line (no title)
c8-reference-only-contradiction: body contradicts the cited paper; citation only in References
c10-doi-wrong-title: resolvable DOI attached to a different paper's title
c11-datacite-doi: DataCite DOI: resolves via handle, no Crossref title
